entries.title: Update 2.0
entries.description: Rewrote the client, there will no longer be any gameplay "mods", rather I am focusing on continuing the beta retexture, which this client will use by default. I've removed a lot of the procedurally drawn textures from the map, so that is why it will look quite empty (for now).
